adds.title: Law of 10 July 2026 on parental authorization - struck down by Court of Justice of Rondonia 17 August
adds.summary: Rondônia's 10 July 2026 law allowed parents to veto gender topics in schools until the Rondônia Court of Justice struck it down on 17 August.
